notes.title: # Last Hit Titan – Patch 1.4
notes.notes: [p]Thank you to the entire community for your feedback and ongoing support. Here are the details of the new features, balance changes, and fixes:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]🚀 Major New Features[/h1][p][/p][h2] Prestige System[/h2][p]- Introduction of the Prestige system:[/p][p]  - Damaging or defeating Titans now grants you Prestige points.[/p][p]  - Once your XP bar is full, you can advance to the next Prestige level.[/p][p]  - When you Prestige:[/p][p]    - Chest prices are reset (chest prices now increase with each purchase).[/p][p]    - Choose one upgrade from four options:[/p][p]      - Chest upgrade  [/p][p]      - HQ upgrade  [/p][p]      - Financial Center upgrade  [/p][p]      - Military Center upgrade[/p][p]    - These upgrades unlock highly anticipated features, such as the ability to buy different types of chests, buy multiple chests at once, and, most importantly, unlock Token slots.[/p][p][/p][h2] Token System[/h2][p]- New Token feature:[/p][p]  - Fuse a large number of towers to obtain Tokens.[/p][p]  - Tokens can be used to upgrade various aspects of the game and further customize your experience.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Exceptional Towers[/h2][p]- Added 3 new towers with a brand new rarity: **Exceptional**.[/p][p]- These Exceptional towers can only be looted from Titans.[/p][p][/p][h2] Tower Fusion System Rework[/h2][p]- You can now fuse up to 100 towers at once![/p][p]- The fusion UI has been completely revamped for a clearer and faster experience.[/p][p][/p][h2]⚙️ Minor Improvements and Fixes[/h2][p]- Theme saving fix: your chosen theme is now correctly saved.[/p][p]- Removed a stray white pixel from the splash screen.[/p][p]- Small UI improvements for a more comfortable gameplay experience.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re eager to hear your thoughts on the new Prestige and Token systems! Thank you for playing Last Hit Titan, and good luck hunting Titans![/p][p][i]*The Summoning Systems Team*[/i][/p]

notes.title: Last Hit Titan — Update 1.3: Combat Types and UI Rework
notes.notes:
This is our first major update tied to the roadmap and will be followed by Update 1.4, expected in mid-June. It brings both core gameplay changes and significant improvements to the user experience.

⚔️ New Gameplay Features :
[list]
[*] Titan Strengths and Weaknesses
[*] Titans now have specific strengths and weaknesses. Towers have different attack types and effects, which means choosing the right combination of towers is now key to defeating titans more effectively.
[/list]

New Titans and Towers :
Several new towers and titans have been added to expand strategic options and challenge.

Titan History and Stats :
You can now click on defeated titan entries to view detailed information and stats about them, including your full elimination history.

🛠️ Minor Features & Quality of Life :
[list]
[*] Tower Shop Button
 A new button has been added in the tower menu to directly access purchasable towers offered by Summoning Systems.
[*]Tower Lock Toggle
A small lock icon in the top left of the screen allows players to disable interaction with placed towers to avoid accidental clicks when targeting titans.
[*]Steam Info Toggle
You can now hide Steam avatars and usernames in the game options for more privacy or focus.
[/list]

🎨 Visuals & Interface
[list]
[*] Complete UI Rework for Tower Descriptions
 Tower info panels have been redesigned for better readability and cleaner aesthetics.
[*] New Color Themes
 The game’s default color palette has been updated. Multiple themes are now available and can be selected from the options menu.
[*] Chest Rewards Grouping
 When opening multiple chests, towers are now grouped by type, making results easier to read.
[*] Tower Alignment Fix
Tower sprites have been realigned to better match their hitboxes, improving visual placement accuracy.
[*] Help Menu Overhaul
The in-game help menu has been reworked and updated with new, relevant information.
[*] Catapult Animation Tweaks
Adjustments have been made to improve the feel and accuracy of catapult tower animations.
[/list]

This update lays the foundation for the Prestige system and Token Fusion, which will arrive in Update 1.4. Stay tuned — and as always, thank you for playing and supporting Last Hit Titan!

notes.title: 🛠️ Roadmap Highlight #1 – Prestige & Token Fusion Progress
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We wanted to share a quick update on the development progress of Last Hit Titan, specifically regarding the first major part of our roadmap.

The game design phase for the Prestige and Token Fusion systems is now nearly complete. These features aim to add depth, long-term goals, and new strategic layers to the game.

We’re planning to roll out these changes in two upcoming updates:

🔹 Update 1.3
This update focuses primarily on a rework of the towers, including a full stat rebalance, the introduction of tower types, and the addition of Titan strengths and weaknesses based on those types.
It will also include graphical improvements to enhance visual clarity and variety.
Internal testing is expected to begin during the week of May 19, 2025.

🔹 Update 1.4
Scheduled for mid-June, this update will build on the Prestige system and introduce the Token Fusion mechanics, giving players long-term progression tools and more customization options.


We’re excited about the direction this is heading and can’t wait to share more soon. As always, feel free to join us on Discord to give feedback or discuss upcoming features.


Thanks for your continued support!
— The Summoning Systems Team

notes.title: 📅 Last Hit Titan – 2025 Roadmap
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce the direction we're taking Last Hit Titan over the coming months. While this is not a full breakdown of every detail, here’s a high-level look at the features and systems we’re actively working on:

🔁 Prestige System
A whole new long-term progression loop!
Prestige Gauge: Defeating and damaging titans fills your prestige gauge. Once full, you can prestige to unlock new tiers.

Scaling Difficulty: Each new prestige tier will take longer to reach.

Chest Pricing Rework: Chest prices will now increase with each purchase and reset at every new prestige.


Prestige Choices: Each prestige lets you choose between powerful upgrades, such as:

[list]
[*] Expanding your base map
[*] Unlocking or improving the Financial Center
[*] Unlocking or improving the Military Camp
[*] Upgrade your HQ 
[*] 
[/list]
🧪 Token Fusion System
Transform your excess towers into powerful upgrades!


Use tokens to upgrade your tower's global stats.

[list]
[*]  Merge 1,000 identical towers to earn a tower-specific token.
[*] Exchange 10 identical tokens to receive a higher-rank version.
[*] Combine different tokens to craft rare synergy tokens with powerful effects — recipes will need to be discovered by the players!
[*] 
[/list]


🧌Titan Behavior Rework:

Titans will receive new behaviors — instead of simply walking across the map, they will interact more dynamically with the environment (special abilities, targeting patterns, movement reactions).

Our goal is to add much more density to titan encounters and make each one feel different.

🆕 New Content
New tower types with unique mechanics.

[list]
[*] New titans with challenging patterns and resistances.
[*] New buildings to help you fight back against adversity 
[/list]

🛡️ Coming Later: Guild System
A longer-term goal, but one we’re excited about:
 Introducing guilds to enhance community interaction, team goals, and collective rewards!

We’re still a small team, but we’re committed to making Last Hit Titan a rich, evolving experience.
 We’ll keep listening and building with the community — thank you for playing and supporting the game!

notes.title: 🛠️ Last Hit Titan – Update 1.2
notes.notes:
⚠️ Breaking Change
Starting from this version, Steam items will now be automatically stacked.
 This drastically reduces inventory size and helps prevent bugs caused by having too many unique items.
ℹ️However, the stacking process may not be completed fully on the first launch — especially for players with large inventories. In some cases, multiple game restarts may be required to finalize the stacking.

⚠️ Note: Since stacked item handling affects many parts of the code, we’ve tested thoroughly, but zero risk doesn’t exist.
 If you encounter any issues, please report them on our Discord.

✨ New Features
Layout System Added
 You can now save and load your map layouts. This makes it much easier to experiment with different setups and strategies.


Titans Can Get Angry
 If you keep changing their path too much, titans may now become enraged!
 You can still redirect them, but beware: an angry titan is a dangerous one.


Delete All Towers Button
 A new quality-of-life feature to instantly clear your map from all towers.

🖥️ UI Improvements
The tower info panel now scales more appropriately when the game window is resized.

🔧 Stability
We’ve fixed memory leaks identified in the previous version. The game should now be more stable over long sessions.

📌 Final Notes
This update doesn't bring a huge number of new features, because our priority was solving the critical issue of large inventories. But that doesn't mean we’re slowing down.
👉 In the coming days, we’ll share our roadmap for the next big changes coming to Last Hit Titan — and we can’t wait to tell you more!

https://discord.gg/HAZhZWaMbE

notes.title: Last Hit Titan - Major Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, here is the patch note for the version 1.1 of Last Hit Titan. But before the path we wanted to highlight some of the player's layout. Let's begin by the most rich player of LHT.

And to begin with, let us introduce you the map of @yuusya !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529950/b5af36020bf003a838e10fd6d35ad90daacd906c.jpg[/img]

Now, here's what's new:

🔧 Fixes

[list]
[*] Titan Kill Achievements Offline Sync: Titan kills made offline will now correctly register and unlock achievements — this also works retroactively!
[*] Merge System Stability: We've improved the merging system to be more reliable and now display the resulting item immediately upon merge.
[/list]

🚀 Improvements

[list]
[*] Titan Pathing Rework: We've reworked how titans move between players. The new system ensures fairer and more consistent progression for all.
[*] Skip Chest Animation Button: Added a button to skip the chest animation for faster looting.
[*] Buy 10 Chests Option: Added the ability to buy 10 chests at once for improved convenience.
[/list]

🛠️ New Features

[list]
[*] Financial Center: A new building that lets you purchase upgrades to improve how you collect gold.
[*] Military Camp: Upgrade your towers’ stats, including damage and elemental effects.
[*] Summoning Systems Tower: A new purchasable tower inspired by our studio’s logo — powerful but not as strong as a legendary tower. It's a great way to support the project!
[*] Titan Activity Display: See when titans visit your map and how much damage you've done during their run.
[*] World Map Enhancements: Now shows which titans are currently active in the world and the list of players they’ll travel through.
[/list]

⚖️ Balance 

[list]
[*] Guardian MK2 tower, fix the stat inversion with Mk1
[*] Gold balancing: Now more damage is needed to fill the towers with gold.
[/list]


We’ve tried to address as much community feedback as possible while respecting our production capacity. We hope this update enhances your experience — and as always, feel free to share your thoughts with us!

notes.title: Patch Notes – Minor Update 1.01
notes.notes:
We’ve released a small but important update to improve stability and add a few quality-of-life features before the next major update. Here's what’s new:

🛠 Bug Fixes

- Fixed a rare crash caused by desynchronization with the server.

- Fixed an issue allowing players to spam the "Buy 5 Chests" button, which could cause bugs.

- Fixed camera lock issues when collecting coins while a monster is overlapping a tower.

✨ Improvements

- Added an auto-fill option for tower fusion to make combining easier.

- Added a simple damage summary at the end of a wave to help you track your performance.

- The world map now supports zooming out further for better visibility.

- The main window can now be resized for larger screens.

We’re aware that there’s still a lot to improve, and rest assured that we’re actively working on it. The team behind LHT is a very small one, but we truly want to deliver the best possible experience.

Our next priorities will focus on how titans move from one player to another, as well as gold collection and the overall in-game economy.

Don’t hesitate to drop by our Discord — it’s where we gather feedback and suggestions most easily: https://discord.gg/HAZhZWaMbE
